text: Contemporary neuroimaging has revised the classical Broca-Wernicke model of language by showing that language processing is:
choices: Distributed across an extensive cortical network rather than localized to two discrete regions
Localized in the right hemisphere in most right-handers
Entirely subcortical, carried out in the basal ganglia
explanation: Large-scale imaging shows language is distributed across an extensive cortical network, revising the classical two-region localization. It is not confined to Broca's area, not right-hemisphere-dominant in most people, and not an entirely subcortical function.
